definitions.explanation: Actions taken after an event, incident, or main process to address remaining issues, clean up, or resolve consequences. Used in business, administrative, disaster management, and technical contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{事後処理|じごしょり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}われている→追う：02016_ou⟧。
examples.english: We are busy dealing with the aftermath of the accident.

examples.japanese: ⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧{終了後|しゅうりょうご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{事後処理|じごしょり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三日|みっか}→三日：02969_mikka⟧ほど⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦{見込|みこ}み→見込み：06872_mikomi⟧だ。
examples.english: Post-event follow-up is expected to take about three days.

examples.japanese: {事後処理|じごしょり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{怠|おこた}る→怠る：03936_okotaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長引|ながび}く→長引く：14473_nagabiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{迅速|じんそく}→迅速：14294_jinsoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: If you neglect the follow-up, problems will drag on, so it is important to respond quickly.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{事後|じご}→事後：07581_jigo⟧ (after the fact, post-) and ⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧ (processing, handling). A versatile compound used whenever there are loose ends to tie up after a main event or process.

USAGE:
Common in business (wrapping up after a project), disaster response (cleanup and recovery), legal contexts (handling consequences), and IT (post-processing of data). The term emphasizes that work remains to be done even after the main activity is over.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事後処理|じごしょり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧: to handle the aftermath
- {事後処理|じごしょり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}われる→追う：02016_ou⟧: to be chased by post-event tasks
- {事後処理|じごしょり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to carry out post-processing
- {事後処理|じごしょり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧: post-processing is delayed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{後始末|あとしまつ}→後始末：07911_atoshimatsu⟧: cleanup, tidying up after — more colloquial and often implies cleaning up someone's mess
- {後処理|あとしょり}: post-processing — similar meaning but slightly more casual; common in technical/IT contexts
- {事後対応|じごたいおう}: post-event response — focuses on responding to consequences rather than routine processing
- {善後策|ぜんごさく}: remedial measures — emphasizes finding the best solution after something has gone wrong
